Kokeiluartikkeli

The first paragraph opens the story. The city council met on Tuesday evening to discuss the new tram line, which has been planned for more than a decade and which would connect the eastern suburbs to the centre in under twenty minutes.

The second paragraph carries the detail the test looks for. Councillors argued for three hours about the cost of the bridge over the river, and in the end they agreed to ask the engineers for a cheaper design before the summer break.

The third paragraph closes the story. Residents who came to follow the meeting said they were relieved that the project is still alive, although many of them doubt that the first trams will run before the end of the decade.

Kokeilusivu, ei oikea uutinen.
